{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:ChewieBreathMask-BTMF19.png|thumb|right|300px|Chewbacca wearing a [[Roamer-6 breath mask/Legends|Roamer-6 breath mask]].]]
A '''breath mask''', '''face breather''', or '''respirator''' was an apparatus that was strapped to the face. It usually had a hose to a filter or air canister, which connected the wearer to a portable [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system. Breath masks provided one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of breathable atmosphere before replacement of the canister was required. The typical breath mask weighed roughly 1.5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. These masks offered no protection from extreme temperatures or a hard [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

The content of the canisters&mdash;also known as air-tanks or breather packs<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>&mdash;varied depending on what [[Species/Legends|species]] was wearing it. As a member of the [[Breather Gand|breather]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] wore a respirator, since he needed to breathe [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]], as [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] atmospheres were [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] to him.<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> He kept the ammonia-filled canisters to his breath mask on his person.<ref name="SWCE" /> The tubes of his respirator were connected to a gas-processing unit, which he carried on his back.<ref name="OFC54">[[Star Wars: The Official Figurine Collection 54|''Star Wars: The Official Figurine Collection'' 54]], back page, "Your Figurine"</ref>

In some cases, respirators were built into a person as [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]], if they suffered severe enough injuries that they cannot live otherwise. Notable examples include [[Darth Malgus]]<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> as well as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

All [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who left [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] wore [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath masks]] because they needed [[Helium/Legends|helium]] and their [[Dorin gas/Legends|own native gas]], as oxygen was poisonous to them as well. The [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] also wore breath masks. 

[[Atmosphere canister]]s typically weighed about one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] and cost 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The breath masks also varied in cost, but from [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], most models were available for 200 credits.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

Breath masks could be built into [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The most famous example of this was [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|Darth Vader's armor]].<ref name="RPG-Core" /> Breath masks were also used to supply breathing gas to a patient while submerged in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]].

Breath masks that could be used [[Water/Legends|underwater]] had in-built [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] so that individuals could keep in contact with one another. The masks also had a switch so that they could put them into speaker mode to communicate with others. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] dispatched to [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] used these masks, and had them in speaker mode to communicate with the native [[Sedrian]]s.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

Some breathers were used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] such as [[Deeve]], of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]]. Deeve's model protected his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with a [[transglass]] piece, but it also stopped him from cleaning out his own sweat. It was also prone to stop being snug. It also included tongue-activated [[monitor pad]]s to perform a quick [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] analysis.<ref name="WEG">{{WEGCite|story=A Typical Survey|book=Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts}}</ref>
